The contract stub is generated by the pipeline; keep its shape when implementing.

Shape (Rust 1.75)

```rust
// Generated by nai contract stubs for word-counter. Keep the signatures; implement the bodies.

/// Count whitespace-separated words.
pub fn count_words(text: &str) -> i64 {
    unimplemented!()
}
```

Rules

- Keep the crate name, exported function names and signatures; tests call them.
- Keep `unimplemented!()` until the behaviour exists: the pipeline proves the test run
  fails with "not implemented" before implementation.
- The build must succeed with the stub: `cargo build --workspace` must pass.
- Every `Cargo.toml` is adapter-owned. Never edit one.
- Integration nodes export `pub fn integrate() -> i64`; run the parent contract's
  scenarios and return the observed result (0 when there is no numeric result).
- Do not add public API the contract does not list.
